headline: PF plunges -50% on debt-meeting news while OKJ and TTCL face SET clarification and rehabilitation proceedings; CONS and FOOD dominate today's risk tape
market_take: Coverage is dominated by sharp idiosyncratic drops rather than broad sector weakness: EMC and TRITN both fell -33% to -50% on thin volume, and PF (PROP) dropped -20% on 1.15× normal turnover after filing debentureholders' meeting resolutions. PF&REIT saw MII flag an 8.1σ volume spike and CPNCG a 3.5σ spike, while PROP names clustered around ±5% moves. The biggest 5-day gainers (GEL +66.7%, PPPM +36.7%, TTCL +33.3%) reflect event-driven small-cap names, with TTCL now tied to a high-severity rehabilitation filing.

sector_notes.note: QQMC dropped -9.09% on an intraday move alert; OKJ fell -5.58% on 3.7× volume the same day it submitted a high-severity SET clarification. KBS and TC flagged volume spikes ≥3.6σ, and XBIO gapped -16.67% then rallied +20.00% intraday.

Severe downside concentration: EMC -50% and TRITN -33.33% both with sub-0.1× volume and matching open-gap alerts. PLE gapped up then reversed -14.29%, while TPOLY was the only CONS gainer at +11.11% on 1.81× volume. TTCL's rehabilitation filing aligns with its +33.3% 5-day move.

PF's -20% drop coincides with two consecutive debentureholders' meeting filings, a clear red flag. STELLA flagged a 3.4σ volume spike alongside its medium-severity progress report; CGD and RICHY both hit opposing open-gap and intraday alerts.
MII triggered the largest volume spike in the digest at 8.1σ vs 20D avg; CPNCG also at 3.5σ. MNRF bucked the trend with +3.96% on very thin volume.
SMO flagged a 6.4σ volume spike, consistent with its high-severity filing on the resignation of the Chairman of the Board and Risk Management Chair.
EPG flagged a 4.9σ volume spike without a price move, and SCC rose +3.31% on 1.12× volume as the only large-cap positive mover in coverage.
